LanguageData.LP_Class_Fighter.label: fighter
LanguageData.LP_Class_Fighter.description: DND fighter: a Melee branch (Second Wind, Charge, War Cry, Trip Attack, Action Surge, Weapon Specialization, Indomitable, Disarming Strike, Whirlwind Attack, Guardian Stance, and ultimately Renewed Fighting Spirit) and a Shooting branch (Steady Aim, Suppressing Fire, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, and ultimately Eye of Death). The Melee branch uses "martial power", the Shooting branch "marksman power". Resource: grit (built up by hitting and killing enemies, fully restored by sleep). Martial class: Extra Attack, fighting style.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Monk.label: monk
LanguageData.LP_Class_Monk.description: The DND monk masters the body with ki: Martial Arts (passive), Flurry of Blows, Deflect Missiles, Stunning Strike, Step of the Wind, Open Hand Technique, Diamond Body, Quivering Palm, and ultimately Empty Body. From level 10 the passive "Still Mind": mind resistance +50%. Strongest unarmed (or with a quarterstaff); fists and kicks use vanilla melee resolution, and Isekai's Strength and weapon mastery apply as usual. Power uses "martial power"; ki effects are multiplied by psychic sensitivity (when the setting is on). Resource: ki (recovered by meditation, fully restored by sleep). Martial class: Extra Attack (unarmed only), fighting style.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Paladin.label: paladin
LanguageData.LP_Class_Paladin.description: The DND paladin wields the oath as a sword: Divine Smite, Vow of Enmity, Sacred Weapon, Swap Guard (Melee, martial power), Lay on Hands, Aura of Protection, Aura of Courage, Banish Evil (Social, divine power), and ultimately Holy Avatar. The weapon hit resolves as usual; the extra holy damage and healing are multiplied by psychic sensitivity (when the setting is on). Resource: divinity (recovered by prayer and meditation, 25% faster for believers of a god, fully restored by sleep). Liches cannot be paladins. Martial class: Extra Attack, fighting style.
